h1: Custom Kraft Napkins for Bulk Orders
metaDescription: Order custom kraft napkins for your business. Eco-friendly and perfect for branding. Get a quote at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Kraft napkins bring a natural, eco-conscious look to any event or food service setting. Made from unbleached, recycled materials, they offer a rustic aesthetic that works well for coffee shops, delis, catered lunches, and trade shows. Unlike white or patterned napkins, kraft napkins communicate sustainability and simplicity. They accept screen-printed logos clearly, making your brand visible while reinforcing an environmentally responsible image.
heroAltText: Stack of custom kraft napkins with printed logo, ideal for eco-friendly branding at events
